boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Johns Hopkins and Baltimore outings with direct evidence that admission or participation costs nothing.

cards.title: Meet the Ancient Objects in Gilman Hall
cards.subtitle: A free museum hang on the Homewood campus
cards.notes: Meet in Gilman Hall and explore the displayed ancient objects; check semester dates because the museum closes during academic breaks.
cards.short_summary: An archaeology-centered meetup inside one of Homewood’s most recognizable academic buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum welcomes the Johns Hopkins community and general public, and admission is free for everyone.
cards.source_title: Visit | Archaeological Museum | Johns Hopkins University
cards.access_notes: Open to the public during posted semester hours; closed April 28–August 30, 2026. Gilman Hall is accessible without a university ID from 8 a.m.–6 p.m.

cards.title: Take in the Peabody Stack Room
cards.subtitle: Five tiers of cast iron and a skylit reading room
cards.notes: Bring a friend for a quiet look at the stack room, then photograph from the public floor without disturbing readers or researchers.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost architectural outing among nineteenth-century books and soaring iron balconies.
cards.evidence_claim: Johns Hopkins Sheridan Libraries states that the George Peabody Library is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free public access during posted visiting hours; visitors must remain on the main floor because the upper tiers are closed for safety.

cards.title: Build a Two-Person Gallery Route
cards.subtitle: Free general admission beside Homewood
cards.notes: Reserve free general-admission tickets, choose two collection areas together, and skip any separately ticketed special exhibition.
cards.short_summary: A flexible art hang where each person selects part of the gallery route.
cards.evidence_claim: The Baltimore Museum of Art states that general admission is always free, although special exhibitions may require separate tickets.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit - Baltimore Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Reserve a free general-admission ticket online or at the Welcome Desk. General admission excludes separately ticketed special exhibitions.

cards.title: Walk the Sculpture Gardens
cards.subtitle: Outdoor art next to the Baltimore Museum of Art
cards.notes: Loop through the outdoor sculptures with a friend and confirm weather conditions first, since storms and extreme temperatures can close the gardens.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor art walk that works without entering a ticketed exhibition.
cards.evidence_claim: The BMA identifies its Sculpture Gardens as part of the free-admission museum visit and says no garden reservation is required.
cards.source_title: Frequently Asked Questions - Baltimore Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: No reservation is required for the gardens. They are weather-dependent and may close during storms or periods of extreme heat or cold.

cards.title: Compare Art Across Centuries
cards.subtitle: An always-free Mount Vernon museum meetup
cards.notes: Pick one unfamiliar gallery each, compare favorite objects afterward, and use the museum map to keep the outing within your available time.
cards.short_summary: A free collection-spanning conversation starter in Mount Vernon.
cards.evidence_claim: The Walters Art Museum says it is always free and open to everyone.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit - The Walters Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Free and open to everyone during posted public hours. Public tours are also free, though registration may be required for particular tours.

cards.title: Walk Cylburn’s Gardens and Trails
cards.subtitle: A free 200-acre green-space outing
cards.notes: Choose a garden-and-trail loop, keep the group out of flower beds, and bring your own water or snacks because no food service operates onsite.
cards.short_summary: A spacious botanical hang combining formal gardens, specimen trees, and wooded paths.
cards.evidence_claim: Cylburn Arboretum Friends states that there are no fees to enter the arboretum, although certain events may charge admission.
cards.source_title: Know Before You Go - Cylburn Arboretum Friends
cards.access_notes: General arboretum entry has no fee. Avoid separately programmed events that require admission, and check current operating hours before leaving.

cards.title: Spread Out a Blanket at Sherwood Gardens
cards.subtitle: A dawn-to-dusk garden hang in North Baltimore
cards.notes: Bring a blanket for a small casual picnic, pack out every item, and stay off the flower beds while exploring the garden’s unpaved lawns.
cards.short_summary: A relaxed garden meetup with seasonal flowers and room for a low-key picnic.
cards.evidence_claim: Sherwood Gardens states that admission is free and that casual blanket picnics are welcome.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public from dawn to dusk year-round with free admission. The garden has no public restrooms, trash receptacles, or paved paths.

cards.title: Greenhouse-Hop at Rawlings Conservatory
cards.subtitle: Five plant houses inside Druid Hill Park
cards.notes: Move through the five greenhouses as a group, compare seasonal blooms, and leave every plant untouched under the conservatory’s garden rules.
cards.short_summary: A warm, plant-filled indoor outing with distinct greenhouse environments.
cards.evidence_claim: Baltimore City Parks states that Rawlings Conservatory is free to visitors and accepts optional donations.
cards.source_title: Druid Hill Park | Baltimore City Parks
cards.access_notes: Visitor admission is free; donations are optional. Check the conservatory’s current hours and closure notices before visiting.

cards.title: Cheer at a Free Home Game
cards.subtitle: Most Blue Jays regular-season contests charge no admission
cards.notes: Check the official schedule, choose a regular-season home contest, and exclude men’s lacrosse, NCAA tournament games, and possible conference-ticketed events.
cards.short_summary: A campus game-day hang built around a no-admission Blue Jays contest.
cards.evidence_claim: Johns Hopkins Athletics says admission is not charged for regular-season home events other than men’s lacrosse.
cards.source_title: Frequently Asked Questions - Johns Hopkins University Athletics
cards.access_notes: Select a regular-season home event other than men’s lacrosse. NCAA tournament games charge admission, and conference championship events may do so.

cards.entity_name: Enoch Pratt Free Library Central Library Tour
cards.title: Tour the Central Library Together
cards.subtitle: A free architecture-and-collections walk in Mount Vernon
cards.notes: Check the current tour calendar, meet inside Central Library, and follow the guide behind the scenes through the building and its collections.
cards.short_summary: A guided social outing focused on the history and architecture of Baltimore’s Central Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Enoch Pratt Free Library advertises a free tour of Central Library covering its collections and building history.
cards.source_title: Central Library - Enoch Pratt Free Library
cards.access_notes: The tour is free; consult the library’s current tour schedule before traveling because tour dates and capacity can vary.
